From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>

Alex—

Appreciate the early heads-up and the bundle. Quick summary of what Redwood needs to validate on receipt and before install (we'll provide a short checklist for the field):

1) Physical chain-of-custody check: seals intact, courier manifest matches, tamper-evidence present.
2) SHA256 checksum verification of signed_bundle_v1.4.tar.gz against bundle_manifest_v1.4.json (manifest includes checksums for every file).
3) Detached signature verification: run our offline verifier (offline-verify v0.3.1) to check signature_v1.4.sig against the published public key (we'll supply key fingerprint).
4) Image signature validation: for container images inside the bundle we expect cosign signatures and entries in the transparency log (we will have an offline rekor mirror snapshot included in the bundle).
5) Staging smoke tests on sequestered node (no external network): start runtime, load model weights into sealed cache, run a lightweight harness with golden prompt set (5 prompts) to ensure model loads and responses are within expected bounds.

Two follow-ups:
- Dev, please provide the exact commands and key fingerprint we want them to use.
- Marissa, can procurement confirm there are no customs hold issues for the SSD transfer on the 20th?

Proposed install window: 2027-06-20 02:00–04:00 UTC (to minimize traffic in the EU/US sites). If that works for Acme we will reserve a canary node for the first 10 minutes and have the fallback automated rolling back to the previous pinned image if health checks fail.

Hannah
Senior Manager, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Alex Rivera <alex@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-12T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Offline bundle transport validation & scheduled install window

Alex / Hannah —

Commands we recommend the on-site engineer run out of the sealed staging network (we will circulate a one-page bash snippet and a minimal python verifier):

# Verify tarball checksum (example)
sha256sum signed_bundle_v1.4.tar.gz | awk '{print $1}'
# compare to manifest entry

# Verify detached signature (cosign/pkcs7 depending on format)
# cosign verify-blob --key redwood_pubkey.pem --signature signature_v1.4.sig signed_bundle_v1.4.tar.gz

# For container images (if images are distributed as OCI dirs):
# cosign verify --key redwood_pubkey.pem oci:image:example

# Offline rekor check (we include rekor-snapshot.tar.gz):
# offline-verify --rekor-snap rekor-snapshot.tar.gz --bundle signed_bundle_v1.4.tar.gz --manifest bundle_manifest_v1.4.json

Key details:
- Redwood public key fingerprint: SHA256:3a:7f:...:c9 (we'll publish full key via SRE portal and include a copy in the manifest).
- We also support HSM-backed verification if the customer has a local HSM — offline-verify accepts PKCS11 URIs.
- Timeouts: verification should take <10 minutes on a modern laptop; image extraction + smoke tests ~20–30 minutes depending on I/O.

If any step fails, the field engineer should stop and call the Redwood on-call number (included in the checklist). We will not proceed with install until signature, checksums, and the 5-step smoke tests pass.

Dev
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

All —

Confirming Redwood approves the install window: 2027-06-20 02:00–04:00 UTC. Final checklist items and the one-page verifier script will be uploaded to the drive link and included in the physical bundle.

Rollback triggers (automated):
- Failed canary health checks (HTTP 500 / repeated inference timeouts) over a 3-minute window.
- Model-serving process OOM or crashlooping for >2 restarts within 5 minutes.
- Any signature / manifest mismatch discovered during verification step.

Manual abort criteria: security team identifies a chain-of-custody discrepancy or tamper evidence, or customs delays leading to unknown custody. In those cases we will quarantine the bundle and require re-signing before a new install window.

Hannah — assigning on-call rotation to myself for the 20th and adding Dev to the 1st-line pager. Marissa please confirm DocuSign completion and courier tracking by EOD 6/18.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the smooth update.

Hannah
